phone_account_pick (0099_phone_account.sql:39-70) keys the name on lower(first word) only; after 90 days unused a different key returns create:true with a new m-<code>-<n> email, and later sign-ins pick the newest account (order by created_at desc, :52-56), so the old one is never reached; the name box (WelcomePhone.tsx:304-317) says nothing about matching. Owner-chosen recycled-number trade-off and the old copy still sits on the server (support could recover), so S2.

staff_reset_pin_with_proof (0061_phone_codes.sql:115-135, never redefined) sets the PIN for every live gym_staff row with the proven number, needing only the WhatsApp code; no migration ever updates gym_staff.phone (grep of every 'update public.gym_staff' finds none setting phone), so a moved owner's old number stays live. Full gym takeover on a recycled number: S1 kept.
